verdict.rationale: n8n ships a first-party 'MCP Server Trigger' node (docs-19, probe-3) that lets an n8n workflow expose itself as an MCP server, allowing external AI agents to connect to it — this directly satisfies the story, and n8n also documents a separate MCP Client node for the reverse direction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server trigger works reliably in production, and more detail on auth/security for exposed MCP endpoints.
